{{C|Essential Legends cover design}} |illustrator= |editor= |publisher=[[Del Rey]] |early release= |release date=[[December 26]], [[2007]]{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/novel/f20071220/index.html|text=Sith Rules: An Interview with Drew Karpyshyn}} |intl release= |rereleased= |media type=Hardcover |pages=318 |isbn=0345477480 |isbn2= |isbn3= |audiobook=[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two (audiobook)|Audiobook]] |timeline=[[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]–[[990 BBY]]{{Blog|DrewK|9|Rule of Two FAQ - warning, very mild spoilers}} |series=''[[Star Wars: Darth Bane Trilogy]]'' |preceded by=[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction|''Path of Destruction'']] |followed by=[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil|''Dynasty of Evil'']] }} '''''Darth Bane: Rule of Two''''' is the follow-up novel to [[2006]]'s ''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''. It was a replacement for the then-canceled [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|Darth Plagueis novel]].{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=04980#16712103|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Sue Rostoni|Eeusu Estornii]]|date=2007-06-18|time=9:57 AM}} It recounts the story of [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] after the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]].{{Blog|DrewK|6|He's baaack...}} A preview of ''Rule of Two'' is available in the paperback release of [[Allegiance (novel)|''Allegiance'']], released the same day as ''Rule of Two''. The paperback was released on [[October 28]], [[2008]]. The paperback has an excerpt of the [[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']] novel.
